comment: Swift/BAT trigger 346386 at 2009-03-13 09:06:27 UT (GCN 8980; T0). Position uses the astrometrically corrected Swift XRT/UVOT location RA=198.40130 deg, Dec=+8.09730 deg, 90% radius 1.8 arcsec (GCN 8991; Swift Report 204.1). The absorption-line redshift is z=3.3736±0.0004 (de Ugarte Postigo et al. 2010, A&A 513 A42, DOI 10.1051/0004-6361/200913113); the nearby SDSS galaxy at z=0.0235 is an intervening object, not the host. GCN 8988 corrects the mistaken cross-reference to GRB 090309 and explicitly classifies this event as long (GCN 8986: T90=78±19 s in 15–350 keV); sub_tag=lgrb.
